notes: Saving an existing visit now sends only the drawings that changed. A visit with 13 canvases uploaded about 4 MB on every save; editing text or one page now sends a few KB, so there is far less time for the connection to drop mid-upload. Unchanged pages are omitted from the request (not sent as empty), so the stored image is kept. The browser also warns before closing or reloading while a save is uploading or a draft still holds unsaved work, and a failed save now says the visit was not saved and the work is still in the form, instead of a generic error. Fixes the aborted-upload log line from 1.3.2, which never actually ran because the framework's 400 status was handled first — client disconnects now log one warning with the byte count instead of a stack trace.
